note: Blender runner config for Creature Studio. The Blender path comes from the environment variable named in blenderEnv, else blenderDefault. Slot lock files go in <work>/slots and logs in <work>/logs. sharedSlot is the machine-wide Blender/GPU lock every pipeline session uses (creature-pipeline design section 10); run_blender takes its blender slot first, waiting up to sharedSlotWait seconds. If it is still busy then (a long GPU job holds the machine), the run goes ahead at below-normal priority only when sharedSlotFallbackFreeGb of memory is free, and the log says so. When every holder of the shared slot has held it longer than sharedSlotLongHoldMinutes (a long render), the wait shortens to sharedSlotShortWait seconds.
